text.tspan: Where each part actually lives: fields on the instance, methods on the prototype, statics on the class itself.
speak() { return this.name + ' makes a sound'; }
assigned to this in the constructor.
Statics belong to the class, not
class is syntax over the prototype chain, not a new object model: the
same lookup rules apply. Two things it does add:
#private fields are enforced by the language (unlike a leading
underscore), and the whole class body runs in strict mode.
